name: Giant Octopus
summary: A large octopus that grapples with tentacles and escapes behind a cloud of ink.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: The octopus can breathe only underwater. It can hold its breath for 1 hour outside water.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=13}) from all eight tentacles. While {ref:condition/grappled}, the target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition.

reactions.name: Ink Cloud
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The octopus takes damage while underwater. *Response:* The octopus releases ink that fills a 10-foot {ref:glossary/cube} centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its {ref:glossary/swim-speed}. The Cube is {ref:glossary/heavily-obscured} for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.
